name: concept_tardragon

desc: A huge heavy dragon monster made of glossy black-purple tar goo, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle, wide dragon head with large spiky fin crests on the back of the head, calm expressionless half-closed eyes, very broad thick chest and shoulders, lower body melting into a black tar puddle, thick slow drips.
